div.head: Cn 1020 17
div.ab: ⁊ gyf hit hwa gedon hæbbe, beo he utlah wið God ⁊ amansumod fram eallum Cristendome ⁊ wið þone cyning scyldig ealles þæs þe he age, buton he ðe raðor geswice ⁊ þe deopplicor gebete wið God.

And if anyone has done so, he shall be an outcast before God and cut off from the whole community of Christians, and he shall forfeit to the king all that he has, unless he desists [from the unhallowed wedlock] as quickly as possible, and makes amends towards God to the utmost.

und wenn es einer gethan hat, sei er geächtet vor Gott und excommunicirt von allem Christenthum und an den König alles, was er besitzt, [zu verlieren] schuldig, wenn er nicht um so schneller [von Sünde] ablässt und um so tiefer vor Gott büsst.

and if anyone has done it, let him be an outlaw before God and excommunicated from all Christendom, and liable [to forfeit] to the king all that he owns, unless he desists [from sin] all the more quickly and atones all the more deeply before God.
